rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: Domain renewed — halcyonthreshold.org extended to Nov 2027 ($14.99)

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for reaching out, and I'm glad Halcyon Threshold came up at the meetup. Unfortunately, the timing doesn't work for me right now — I'm not in a position to be quoted publicly this week. If your piece or a follow-up extends into late November or December, I'd be happy to talk then. Best of luck with the deadline. Morgan"
rows.quote: Tessa Brandt (reporter) — Politely declined the quote request, citing timing.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thank you for including me. I support the call for independent safety audits on frontier systems, but I'm not able to sign on publicly this week due to other commitments I need to resolve first. If you run similar initiatives in the future, please do reach out again — I'd like to stay connected. Best, Morgan Hale"
rows.quote: Corvid Institute (open letter) — Declined signing on this week, expressed support for the cause

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — this means a lot, especially coming from someone with your skills. I'm still working out exactly what Halcyon Threshold will focus on, but having a capable data analyst willing to contribute five hours a week is genuinely valuable. A few areas where help could matter: 1. Research synthesis — there's a lot of AI safety/governance literature, and I'd love to build a resource that makes it more accessible 2. Eval work — if we decide to contribute to model evaluations, data skills would be central 3. Grant landscape mapping — understanding what's funded and what's neglected Would you be up for a short call this week or next to talk through what interests you most? I'm flexible on timing. Thanks again for reaching out. Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya Raman (volunteer) — Warm response accepting her help, suggested a call to discuss focus areas.

rows.text: Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.
Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.
